subject.summary: Photo-inferred narrow ochre/russet two-bay neighbor immediately right of the broad yellow mansard house and behind Börshuset. Unidentified address; hidden lower facade, rear and footprint are conservative inference, not documented architecture.

sources.title: Agent/supervisor inferred two-bay crop reconstruction, envelope and hidden backs; not user measurements

facts.value: Approximately 6 m wide, 10 m deep, eave 18 m; roof ridge about 23 m and chimney about 24.1 m. All metric dimensions are inferred, not photo measurements.
facts.note: Agent/supervisor production estimate refined from the visible crop, not user measurements, survey or a complete facade count. Historic image comparison shows that crop can omit bays.
Visible-in-reference only: lamp, foreground stall and right-edge architecture obscure much of this facade. A cropped two-axis reconstruction must not imply two total building bays.
facts.value: Narrow ochre/yellow-appearing facade fragment with pale trim, dark sloping roof and a curved eave detail toward the right of the visible crop. Full facade and street level are obscured.

facts.note: No published height/footprint or measured coordinates applied; hidden surfaces and cropped repeats remain modeler estimates.
facts.value: Existing six-metre-wide two-bay house is a production completion from a crop, not a verified complete building. Rear door, walls, depth and returns are inferred.

facts.note: Documented non-metric statement; not a verified measurement. Catalogue address and unknown architect are source statements; no construction year is supplied. This alone does not verify the modeled two-bay building identity.
facts.value: ArkDes catalogue ARKM.B12924 names Aesculapius2 and locates it at Stortorget14; architect is listed as Okänd.

facts.note: Documented non-metric statement; not a verified measurement. 1960 is the photograph date, not construction date.
facts.value: Stadsmuseet photograph F64132 by Lennart af Petersens is titled Stortorget16-14 and dated 1960.

facts.note: Visual comparison on the municipal webpage, not a measured survey or construction record. Do not repair geometry in this provenance-only audit.
facts.value: The matching right-hand facade in the 1960 municipal photograph shows three principal upper window axes and a centrally curved eave, whereas this model has two axes and a right-biased curved detail. Stortorget14/Aesculapius2 is a candidate, not a verified exact model reconstruction.
